in_sanskrit.name: कृष्णा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who takes away all pain and sorrow, the one who is all-attractive, the one who is the source of all pleasure, and the one who is the supreme goddess.

in_hindi.name: कृष्णा
in_hindi.meaning: कृष्ण के परिवार में वह माँ
in_hindi.long_meaning: She is the divine mother of Lord Krishna and is the embodiment of love, compassion, and maternal care.

in_tamil.name: கிருஷ்ணா
in_tamil.long_meaning: She is the consort of Lord Krishna and is the embodiment of grace, beauty, and love.

in_telugu.name: కృష్ణా
in_telugu.long_meaning: She is the queen of the cowherd community and is the embodiment of love, grace, and beauty.

in_marathi.name: Krishnaa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Krishnaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Darkness, Blackness; a form of Goddess Radha, or an incarnation of Goddess Durga

in_bengali.name: Krishnaa
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Darkness, Blackness
in_bengali.long_meaning: Krishnaa একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Darkness, Blackness; a form of Goddess Radha, or an incarnation of Goddess Durga
